inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, index README, sample JSON record, component-index markdown, file counts, and license

anchors.why: Identifies the repository as JSON recipes generated by the recipebook application and exposes alphabetical and component indexes.
Provides the top-level alphanumeric navigation map from numbers and letters to subindexes.
Shows recipe JSON fields: directions, ingredients, language, source, tags, title, and url.
Shows a generated component index that links an ingredient/style token to many JSON records.
MIT license for the repository, separate from the provenance status of original recipe sources.

known_limits: The repository license does not automatically settle the status of upstream recipe source content.
Generated component indexes are activation/navigation aids, not reviewed relations.
Large JSON count and broad coverage do not imply evidence strength.
